batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b SR Watson

batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b JP Faulkner

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b MG Johnson

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c SL Malinga b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: JP Faulkner
batting.dismissal: c GJ Maxwell b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c PP Ojha b MG Johnson

batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b PP Ojha

balls.text: gone, run-out off the last ball, it was fuller on the pads, flicked to the deep mid-wicket region, they take a single and Malinga wants to come back for the second, he comes back but Harbhajan decides he prefers a not-out next to his name and Malinga is easily run-out there
looks to get his front foot out and wants to crash it over the leg side, it's too quick for him to go with the fact that it's cramped him up, hits the pads
full-toss on the off-stump channel and that's pushed down to long-off for a single

gone, caught, straight to short fine-leg! it was a full-toss on the middle stump, he was looking to scoop it over the fine-leg fielder, gets it off the middle of the bat alright but the placement isn't what he would have wanted, straight to the fielder at pace
and was looking to crack it over the leg side but saw that the delivery was very full and only nudges it to the leg side for a single
yorker length and on the off stump, drilled down to long-on for a single

shot, six, difficult to be in the bowler's shoes at such times, it was short of length, and was looking to pull it away, gets a slice away over the backward point, would you believe it, that mis-hit has gone all the way! Good over ends with a six.
full-toss on the middle and that's cracked away to the leg side for a single, finally off the strike!
and again, fourth dot in a row, a well-pitched up slower one and this time he gets some bat on it and lobs gently to the off side
swings and misses yet again! beaten for lack of pace on that one, was a length delivery and Johnson never read that, three dots in a row
and this is a quicker yorker, he only manages to dig it out back to the bowler, wanted the single but is sent back
slower one, a very slow one in fact, he was a day too early into his stroke and that's gone through him

that's a very fuller length ball and outside the off stump, he was looking to dig it out with an almost-horizontal bat, gets a beautiful piece on timing on it and is able to fine the fine third-man fence for a four

and this time he's caught, gets it away to deep mid-wicket where Samson takes it very well! the ball was fuller, Rayadu loves going back and he seemed to have thought that this was the one he could have tonked over the fielders, the pace seemed to have been taken off there and there's no timing on, holes out to Samson just a yard inside the fence
short of length and outside the off, he was looking to unwind there but can only tap it away to long-on for a single
cracked away through extra-cover for a single, fuller outside the off stump and pushed to deep cover
shorter in length and he is camping on that back foot yet again, wanting to cut away, misses the outside edge of the bat

his first movement to the back foot as if he wants to hoick it over mid-wicket but sees the delivery outside the off and fuller, opens the face of the bat to third-man fir a single, there was a misfield and they come back for the second
what timing that, it was fuller on the off stump, Harbhajan was looking to defend at it and that's crunched through the in-field for a couple of runs
on the off stump, pushed to the off side for a single

leading edge, and he's gone! run-out! this was a good delivery and deserved a wicket, the ball bounced more than he expected and takes the leading edge to the off side, Cooper does not get close to it on the full but he's quick enough to run to it, pick up and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Pollard was slow to get to that end, did not dive and he's quite outside the crease. A very, very good throw that.
wide outside the off stump, very full too, Pollard was looking to steer it down but it's given a wide, don't think it was that wide!
on a length and outside the off stump, he opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
yorker length ball and he was back on his crease and flicking it to the leg side, they take a single and come back for a very quickly taken second run, the throw isn't a good one from deep square-leg
shorter in length and on the off stump, pushed to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and outside the off stump, pushed to the off side for a single

top-edged and he's gone! it seemed to be a slower one and he was looking to pull it away, was attempting to help it away and the ball balloons high up in the air and Watson from short fine-leg takes a very well-judged catch there
blazed away through the covers for a four! was outside the off and on a length, he has hit it cleanly and through the line for a four, he's away very quickly again
fuller on the middle stump again, well bowled that, again left with no option but to dig it out to the off side
shorter in length and he was looking to hook it away, rises more than he expected and beats the bat...it looked to have taken off there
and now it's down the leg side for a wide, was on a length and bit of movement down his pads
yorker length and the batsman's got no chance but to dig it out, no bat swing and tapped back to the bowler
length ball but closer to the batsman, not giving him width this time and the swing back into the batsman means that it beats him and hits the pads, rolls over to the leg side
shorter in length and this time he has bit of width to get his arms swinging, gets it through mid-wicket for a four!
wants to push the length up, outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat and gets it to third-man for a single
ooh, it was on a length and a bit of movement back into him, did not know whether to go forward or back, gets bit of an inside edge to the leg side
shorter outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
shorter in length, on the off stump and tapped to the leg side, go off for a very quick single, the fielder comes in from mid-on and has a quick shy at the non-striker's end, Pollard's well in
on his pads and tipped to the leg side for a single
and that's the Pollard we know, it was fuller in length and Pollard swings his arms through the line of the ball, gets it straight over his head for a six
fuller on the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
shorter, wider and that's easily guided away through the backward point area for a four, very well-timed that one!
for the second time in the over, there's bit of a tossing up from the bowler and Pollard wants to go over the top, gets a bit of an inside edge to long-on
tosses it up and on the off stump, Pollard gets his long legs out and defends it back to the bowler
fuller outside the off stump and crunched but straight to the short cover fielder
full-toss outside the off stump and tapped to wide long-off for a couple of runs

chipped away and easily caught off a slower ball! took the pace off and was outside the off stump, he was looking to clear the in-field but plays his shot way too early, he's beaten and the ball lobs up for Watson to take a good catch running back
slows down the pace, it's outside the off stump and beats him
powerfully hit yet again, on a length outside the off and punched down the ground for a couple of runs, Faulkner comes across tidies up
fuller on the middle stump, tapped down to long-on for a single

missed, stumping missed there, difficult alright but it has to count as a chance, he was looking to go down the track and gets bit of an edge, the keeper does not get a glove there and it's gone for a four
and now he's caught! wanted to slog sweep it yet again, this time it's been hit to the deep mid-wicket fielder, where Samson takes a good tumbling catch to send back Karthik
slogged away for a four! that was fuller, bowled from very behind the popping crease and it does not look like Karthik's got it off the middle, still beats the outfield easily
wants to slog it away yet again, gets bit of an inside edge for a single
whoa, that's been taken from being very full and almost from the middle stump, sweeps it to short fine-leg
on his pads and easily nudged away to deep mid-wicket for a single
yorker length this and he can only dig it out to third-man for a single

slower on his pads and that's flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single, he rushed back to get his second and the throw from Cooper is right next to the stumps but he seems to be in. Third umpire concurs and that's brought up his 50, a good innings this.
on a length and angling away from the batsman, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
full-toss, quicker outside the off stump and that's drilled through to the deep cover fielder for a single
and again! it was on a length and the long-off was brought into the circle at mid-off, he manages to get it over that fielder for a four
wow, what power, it's a slower one from JF and fuller outside the off stump, Tare drills it through to wide long-off for a four
wants to sweep it away, but its slower and he misses it, beaten
top-edged for a four, there was no fine-leg in place, the fielder was inside the circle, he sweeps it away and it goes off the edge over short fine-leg
wanted to slog it away, gets an inside edge to the leg side for a single

was looking to go back and cut it away, this time he misses getting it off the middle, there an appeal for an lbw but its come off the bat, they get a single, after which there's an overthrow at the bowler's end
fuller outside the off stump and driven back to the left of the bowler, tumbling stop
tosses it up and he was going down the track, gets bit of an inside edge through to the leg side for a single
slows down the pace and shortens the length, wants to cut it hard but can only tap it to point
fuller from the bowler and he looks to hit it really hard, goes back to the bowler who stops it on his follow-through
on a length, outside the off stump and tapped down to long-on for a single
quicker outside the off stump, on a length and driven through to deep cover for a single
that's an attempted slower ball, in fact it was slow alright but the direction was woefully off, on the middle and fuller, swivels away to fine-leg for a four
fuller on the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
fuller on the middle stump and driven down to long-on for a single
and this is down the leg side, beats the batsman and not given a wide, probably came off the pads
ooh, beaten, that was on a length and it spins sharply away from the bat, beats the outside edge
on his pads, fuller and that's tapped away to deep square-leg for a single
not very short, was on a length but turning away from the batsman who rocks back quickly and cuts it through to deep point for a couple of runs
shorter in length and tucked away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, flatter and it's far wide outside the off
another one shorter in length and this time he gets it off the meat of the bat, smacked over the in-field and through wide long-on for a four
and hes dropped! Dravid's spilled a sitter! shorter in length and he wanted to pull it away, goes straight to him at short mid-wicket, and it's spilled
on a length outside the off and swinging away, driven down to long-off for a single
and off the middle of the bat yet again, fuller on the off stump, pushes it to the off side where the short cover misfields
wow, what a shot! that was superbly timed, fuller outside the off stump and there was a long-off in place, it goes to his left and he fails to get close to it
on the off stump line and he opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
shot, that's a very good one, fuller on the leg stump and he's driven it over the long-on region for a six, hit off the middle of the bat that one!

wow, that's been given a serious hammer, it was fullish in length and he absolutely smashed it, went straight to Cooper at mid-on, who makes a mess of it and allows them to take a couple, takes a stinging blow on his finger too
length ball on the off stump and he's on the back foot, tapping it back
quicker, on a length and angling back into the batsman, he was quickly on his back foot looking to tuck it away, hits him on his pads and there's an appeal, not given, drifting down
it's another shimmy down the track and this time Karthik gets it off the middle of the bat, a good tap down through mid-off for a four
comes down the track and takes it on the full, taps it to the off side
down the leg side that's been kept well there, was a wide alright but could have easily slipped away for five wides like what we saw in the Pune game, a diving keeper makes a good stop to his left
shorter, slower and that's cut hard but again straight to the fielder at point fielder
tries to cut it away but can get it away only to the backward point fielder, Hodge does well
and slogged away yet again for a four, this was slower and fuller from round the stumps but he stopped the shot and deposits it in front of square
outside the leg stump and this gives him the license to smack it away, gets enough bat on it and rolls away to fine-leg for a four
goes down the track to slog it away but it's a tad slower and beats the advancing stroke, hits his pads
fuller from round the stumps, tapped back to the bowler
good length outside the off stump, defended off the middle of the bat, rolls over to the off side
and he flays at it, misses, beaten! was on a length and wanted to crack it through the off side, there was bit of an out-swing there and goes through
was trying to play across yet again and does not connect, rolls over to the off side and a single
bounce from Watson, was shorter in length but that's got Karthik hopping, hits his pads and they go for a leg-bye

gone, lbw, Watson's got his fellow Aussie here! it was on the middle stump and swinging back into the batsman, he was looking to jam his bat down quickly but it seems to have escaped it and hit the back thigh, the umpire thought for many a seconds before giving it. Watson's given him a nice, little farewell too.
very full, very straight and there's a lot of respect in that defensive stroke to the off side
quicker and flatter, patted to the off side and not for a run
and he is not holding back, was going down the track to smack it over the in-field, gets an inside edge that runs away to fine-leg for a single
shortens his length, on the middle stump and wants to cut it away, not off the middle to the short cover
and now it's been smashed over the bowler's head for a six! it was fuller and Maxwell's tonking them away, over the bowler for a max!
and again, this was outside the off stump, was looking to hoick it away but not off the middle of the bat, couple of runs to the left of deep mid-wicket
short, slow and Maxwell's rocked back and smashed it over mid-wicket for a six, missed four, hit two
top-edged and landed between three fielders, third-man was the closest to it but the slip and the point fielder was also going for it, in the end they get a single, what an over that!
misses again, bowls a quicker one and on a length, for the fourth time in the over he was looking to smash it away, beats the outside edge
slower one, full-toss and this time he connects, it did not come out properly from JF and he was easily able to spank it over the long-on area for a six
and again, this time he was looking to hit it straighter but gets no touch on the bat, was slightly fuller but angling away and he misses
and now he wants to send him into the Arabian Sea, was on a length outside the off stump and he was looking to hoick it away, beats the outside edge
outside the off stump, on a length and a bit of bounce, he was looking to crack it through the covers, gets an inside edge to fine-leg for a single
goes for the reverse slog, but for one, it's very slow coming on to the bat and then it turns away from the batsman, beats him
on the back foot and taps it through to deep mid-wicket for a single
slows it down, bit of turn away from the batsman and he guides it to backward point for a single
quicker and on the pads, was looking to play it round the corner, hits the pads
keeps it up to the bat from round the stumps and Maxwell defends it back to the bowler
fuller on the middle stump and it's pushed back to the bowler
slower one and outside the off stump, was looking to tonk it away but beats him
full-toss, swinging into the batsman who looks to slog it away, but it's too quick for him, hits the pads and runs away for a leg-bye
and again tries to drill it away but he suddenly seems to have found those yorkers right and he can only tap it away for a single
wow, that's been deposited into the crowd! it was an another yorker attempted and it's been struck well enough to go overlong-off for a maximum!
goes to swing at it and is beaten, yorker length yet again and no touch on that one through to the keeper

gone, yorker length and given out lbw! it was a full-toss in the end and Hodge was looking to swing it across the line, that was his best option there and he misses, the yorker dipped on him and beats him, the umpire has no doubt giving him out there
poor ball that, full-toss and that should have been smacked through fine-leg for a four, instead it's hit straight to the fielder, was that over the waist?
smashed it down the ground for a couple of runs, looked to have been hit off the middle of the bat but Harbhajan does well to get around from long-off and restrict them to two
finally a four! this was full-toss, outside the off stump and gets it over the point to find the fence
up and over but not hit strongly enough to beat the man at deep extra-cover, the fielder runs over to the right and restricts them to a couple
wow, that's a good ball, it was a yorker-length ball that sneaks through the legs and beats him
drilled away over point for a single, it's Rayadu at deep point and Binny wanted a second but Hodge sends him back
wants to swing it away and all he can do is to get some inside edge on it, rolls back to the keeper who has a shy at the stumps again, misses
another yorker and he's left with no option but to get some bat on it and rush off for a single
slapped well to one that's pushed up to the bat but it goes on the bounce to Pollard at long-off
well bowled yorker length ball and it needs a lot of skills from the batsman to drill it through to wide long-off for a couple of runs
full-toss, was looking to swing it away, gets to Rayadu at square-leg who misfields and they are away for a run
that's quick, 138.7 km/hr and yorker-length, beats the batsman who then tries to go for a bye, Karthik is alert and sends down the throw at the striker's end, misses
shorter in length, slower in pace and this time he fails to make contact on that one as he looks to guide it to third-man
inside edged and for a four, he was looking to give himself room but all he manages to do is get an inside edge, the good news for RR? it beats the keeper and rolls over to the fence!
looks to walk across to the off side and loop it over the short fine-leg fielder, hits his pads and rolls over to the leg side for a single
and that's another shorter one, was looking to pull it away but gets no bat on it
wants to go down the track, it's a slower one and he can only get it high on his bat while trying to attempt that pull, the ball's mis-hit which helps them come back for a well-run second
slower one from MJ and he was looking to cut it away, beats the outside edge of the bat
defended back to the bowler to end what has been an excellent over for the Royals
opens the face of the bat and gets it through backward point for another couple of runs, good shot, Johnson goes after it and does well to pull it back but it hits him and rolls over to the fence!
wow, Rayadu's dropped it now! it was slog swept and was going to deep mid-wicket, where he needed to jump up a little, seemed to had it covered but spills it and it goes to the fence
defended off the back foot and back to the bowler
it's caress again for want of a better word, this time it's deftly played behind the backward point with lot less power but it's four all the way
shorter in length and he's almost caressed it to the off side and it races away to the deep cover fence for a four
fuller on the off stump this time and nicely driven to long-off for a single to retain the strike
yorker length yet again and it's flicked away to backward square-leg for a single
well bowled yorker and he digs it to long-on for a single
full-toss down the leg side, and that's been given a wide, a tickle on that would have got him a four there, poor delivery
yorker length and dug out well but back to the bowler, jumps high to field it
and again, this is further up and driven to the off side, but this time he does not get it in the gap, straight to the fielder
that's drilled away to the fence! Malinga pitched that one up to the bat and gave him width too, cracked it away by Hodge
down the leg side, was a poor ball and that's swept away over fine-leg for a four! good shot that
outside the off stump, tapped to the off side and they are through for a single
almost lobbed back to the bowler there, was slowed up and gets a leading edge back to the bowler, falls just short
fuller and on the off stump, driven straight to short cover
fuller from round the stumps, tapped to mid-on this time
outside the off stump, turn away and steers it to short third-man for a single
wow, what a delivery and that seems to have missed the bat, pad and the stumps, Karthik gets no gloves on it either and it runs away to the fence for four byes
bowled him now, Harbhajan has a wicket! he had to go after the bowling here with the required rate so high, he went down the track but misses, sneaks through and the stumps are rattled
another edge between the bat and the pad and it rolls over through short fine-leg for a couple
was looking to slog sweep it but the ball does not come on, gets an inside edge
round the stumps and quicker on his pads, hits his pads too and there's an appeal but going down
shorter, on the off stump and that's cut hard and through the gap between short third man and backward point, and once it beats them, there's only one place it's headed
reverse slogged this one, was fuller and cannot find the gap, hit straight to deep point for a single
fuller and he goes down the track and chips it over to long-on for a single
quicker and some turn away from the bat, beats the outside edge
and this is very well hit, it was shorter in length and he goes back and cracks it through the point region for a four
tries to go inside out, for a moment it looked like it was not hit well but the result is a six over long-off!
oh wow, that's well bowled now, he flights it up, slows it down and he was looking to go down the slog it away, it turns into him and hits his body
goes for a reverse hit, the ball was pitching on the leg-stump in his normal pose, gets a top-edge and runs away through short third-man to the fence
fuller on his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side for a single
bounce again, it was on a length and he was looking to cut it away, gets it away to point
fuller from round the stumps, lot of bounce there as he was looking to defend it back, almost rolls back
that's down the leg side and he tries to sweep it away, almost goes all the way to the fence, Malinga makes a sprawling effort after a good chase and the third umpire rules it's done cleanly
fuller outside the off stump and swept away to the leg side for a single
on his pads and that's been flicked away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and this time is able to tuck it away to the leg side
that's turned back into the batsman, was looking to defend and it hits the pads
driven through the covers for a single
ooh, in the air and almost hit to the fielder, it was outside the off stump and was looking to drive it away, the spin beats him, scoops up to the point

short ball and that's been caught by Pollard. irony of the situation, it was shorter, he goes on the back foot to try and smack it over mid-wicket, gets a top edge and Pollard not only takes the catch but also celebrates hard, he sure looks to have enjoyed sending back Watson.
punched down the ground for a single, which also brings us the time-out
again not too much timing on that one, he was looking to give himself room to hit it inside out but gets it to long-off for a single
fuller on the off stump and tapped to the off side, away for a quickly taken run
that just does not come on to the bat and he was looking to pull it away, gets the toe end of the bat
this one's on his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side for a single
shorter one and cut away to backward point for a couple of runs, good throw but the running is better
down the leg side and for five wides, we have seen many of them today, haven't we? it was a quicker one and down the leg side for five wides

and another one, this wasn't quite off the middle of the bat but who cares anyway! that was always headed one way, and that's over the fine-leg fielder for a six, it was another bouncer attempted and this was a tad higher, gets a top-edge and gets two in two!
shot for a six! that was a shorter delivery and boy that was hit flat and hard and for a six!
fuller on the middle stump and that's driven down to long-on for a single
shorter in length, quicker too and tapped to third-man for a single
leading edge that scoops over the in-field on the off side, lobs over the fielders and gets a single
slower delivery outside the off and beats the batsman for the lack of pace, through to the keeper
shorter in length and tapped down to long-on for a single
down the leg side and that's called a wide, Dinesh Karthik was going for another appeal there and aborts it, thankfully.
quicker on the off stump and that's tapped to the off side for a quick one
on his pads and he leaves that alone, hits his pads and rolls away to the leg side
fuller from Harbhajan and that's driven back to the bowler
on his pads and fuller, flicked away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single, Watto wanted to come back for the second but is sent back
outside the off stump, and opens the face of the bat to the off side
opens the face of the bat and steers it to third-man for a single
short of length and that's cut, but straight to the point fielder on the bounce

and now he's gone high, but not too handsome, it's been caught! was on the middle stump and he was looking to hit it over the top, was full enough to go after it too but somehow I felt he did not get his foot out too much and it's gone high, falls into the laps of the waiting Malinga
ooh, bad shot that, it was on a length and without too much foot movement, Rahane was looking to dab it down, beats the outside edge through to the keeper
shot sir, that was travelling and Maxwell does well to get his hand out and stop it at point, was short and wide and cut hard
fuller on the off stump and he defends it off the front foot
short of length and he's quickly on to the back foot, tapped away to the leg side for a single
on the middle stump, short of good length, defended to the off side

mis-hits it to wide mid-on and Ojha takes the catch! it was a short of a length ball and the batsman was looking to pull it over the in-fielder, he gets it high on the bat, lobs up to the right of the fielder, Ojha runs across to take the chance
fuller on the middle stump, defended to the off side
outside the off stump and he's gone after it, was fuller too, but does not get close to it, beats the outside edge

short of length, outside the off stump and he has played at it, almost like he wants to guide it down to third-man, instead what do we have here? it goes crunch, over the point fielder and to the third-man for a four!
pitches it slightly shorter yet again and he manages to go back and defend it to point where Maxwell fields
fuller on the middle stump and defended back to the bowler
gone, caught, was trying to slice it away and can get only a top-edge on that one, goes high in the air, Maxwell runs back to take a good catch
on his pads and that's tucked down to fine-leg rather well, the fielder was up inside the circle and he's got to give it a good chase, push it back and reduce it to 3
shorter in length and pushed to the off side thing time, not for runs
middle stump line and that's tapped to the leg side for a quickly taken single
and this time he has some width which he uses to steer it to third-man for a single
very close to the bat, on the off stump and on a length, he's rooted to his back foot, only manages to defend it to the off side
shorter in length and he is immediately on his back foot, gets an outside edge that runs to third-man for a single
slightly outside the off stump, swinging back into the batsman, pushed off the back foot to mid-off for a single

in the air and over the point fielder for a four, it was on a good length and angling away from the batsman, he throws his bat at it and it runs away over the in-field and gets him his second boundary
fuller on the off stump and driven to point, not for runs
on the back foot, almost squares him up and gets an outside edge to the third-man region for a single
shorter in length yet again and punched straight to the covers, there's a call of 'wait on' immediately after that
defended off the front foot, back to the bowler, that was on a length and does well to get his bat and pad together there
short of length and that's pushed to the point fielder
outside-edged for a four, it was outside the off stump and he gave it his bat, gets it over the slips and it races away
short of length, gets a bit of bounce and he looks to nudge it to the leg side, hit on his pads, rolls away for a leg-bye
short of length and on his pads, tapped to the leg side

bouncer and that's been given! whoa, now I have never seen this before. This was short, a bouncer and he was looking to pull it away, missed it, the keeper went up in appeal and the umpire gives it out. So far so good. But then comes Dravid's reaction, who stays there for a few seconds and lets out a frustrated rant, probably in the direction of the umpire, walks back to the dugout and almost slams his bat in disgust. Replays suggest it hadn't hit the bat
